notes.title: Dead Age 2 polish language, Dead Age: Survivors Small News Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36253678/604c6056633bad0f90f12a9158b12a4e39346436.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16438/Dead_Age_12_Bundle/ 

Greetings survivors!
[b]It's February and we have a Dead Age 2 update for the Polish language + some small news for the upcoming Dead Age: Survivors. [/b]

Witajcie polscy gracze!

[b]Finally we have the polish translation for Dead Age 2, thanks to Steamplayers bax001 (translator) and Matiko13 (tester). [/b] Many thanks for this voluntary work! So Polish players, I hope you will have fun and will try to survive in Freedom City!  If you find any language errors and want to let us know, please use this thread: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/951430/discussions/0/3376032962080764008/

You can also meet us in Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/5n6sdcJ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36253678/39e38a25d692d0b2acc5d73aeccccadae40d64d7.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36253678/7a043625bed512eb39aa8434509dc1db43e7908e.png[/img]

First of all, the bad news. I got rheumatism in both wrists (I had played too many Gothic 2 mods ;)) and could only work extremely little the last months. This delayed the development of Dead Age: Survivors, but thanks to medication I can now work much better again and things are progressing.

My best friend Steven ... uhm ... Sandro is currently working on the desert maps and they look pretty nice. We will bring some pictures at Easter.

I'm currently working on the dialog and quest scripting for the new faction: The Lost Ones. [b]The story should be a bit more exciting and atmospheric than in Dead age 2[/b]. For me, that's always the coolest thing to work on ;-)
In programming Simone and Pedro are still busy with bugfixing our prototype, but after that it will be about the expansion of the new strategy features, because Dead Age Survivors will have [b]a conquest and defense feature of areas.[/b]
  
We will tell (and show) you more about [b]Dead Age: Survivors[/b] in the future - so make sure to follow the game and add it to your wishlist. This would really help us a lot! 

Have Fun ,
Rayk (Holy Avatar), Sandro, Pedro and Simone!
Silent Dreams Team

notes.title: Dead Age 2 Italian Language & Dead Age Survivors News
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36253678/bbf8a5258b75679cb75f545dd4b983be9e4c5d8b.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16438/Dead_Age_12_Bundle/ 

Greetings survivors!
[b]It's summertime and we have a Dead Age 2 update for the Italian language + a regular Engine update, if you need it later. Another good news: Dead Age 2 will finally be released for modern consoles (PS5 and Xbox Series S/X). The date is August 8th.[/b] and a bad but also a very good message for new Dead Age: Survivors. 

 [b]Please add it to your wishlist and support us Indie RPG Devs & Gamers[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117160/Dead_Age_Survivors/

Ciao italiani!

You have one of the coolest accents of all languages and the Steamuser Coccoloco has built you this version. Thank you very much and have fun!  If you find any errors and want to let us know, please use this thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/951430/discussions/0/3003304734669635509/

You can also meet us in Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/5n6sdcJ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36253678/39e38a25d692d0b2acc5d73aeccccadae40d64d7.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36253678/7bc7e4dbd0250256b819d32037f3d40aa1e1beef.png[/img]

First of all, the bad news. Silent Dreams went bankrupt after 18 years and 6 released RPGs due to financial problems and most of the people had to look for new jobs. It was a horror time for me (with 4 diseases at the same time!) because Silent Dreams is my baby (like the captain and his ship ;-)) but in the end it wasn't that bad. 

[b]A real life indie story about hard times and ascent.[/b]

I am now unemployed, but a real fighter. My soul is working like this: https://youtu.be/KpzfdkTuiC4?t=35 I'm now working full-time with Simone an Italian indie RPG developer and 3 part-time programmers and 1 artists (my best buddy Sandro who worked on Settlers, for example,) [b]We work without money, but with a lot of passion, because after my horror time now comes the ascent!!![/b]

But it has to be clear that we are taking our time, because time stress is one of the worst problems in the dev business. Dead Age Survivors should be finished in 2026 and that has some advantages.

[b]+ I have time for new quests, a new faction "The Lost" and events that weren't even planned. This is supposed to be the best Dead Age![/b]

[b]+ I play the version all the time, so the version will have few bugs once we go into Early Access[/b]

[b]+ We will start a Kickstarter campaign before Early Access, we will then use this money to bridge the development time until release. Now Kickstarter had better times, but I think we can convince fans, especially since there is no risk, we are doing this just before Early Access to launch Silent Dreams 2.0 [/b]

[b]+ The combat needs some improvements and we want to get that under control and have cool (small) teams of about 10 people compete against each other to conquer or defend territories. But the troop combat still has to be realized.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36253678/dfd50172b209e7e0f2952e4d918cb720cd2421c0.png[/img]

Since I used to have a bigger team and had todo with lot of gamedesign and project management, I've spent the last few months learning how to script quests, which was previously done by a programmer. Here you can see what it looks like.
In principle you will be overwhelmed with information at the beginning, but if you work your way from note to note, you will gradually understand how many possibilities our quest and event system has.
  
We will tell (and show) you more about [b]Dead Age: Survivors[/b] in the future - so make sure to follow the game and add it to your wishlist. This would really help us a lot! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117160/Dead_Age_Survivors/

Happy Summerdays
Rayk (Holy Avatar) & the (part-time ;-)) Silent Dreams Team

notes.title: Dead Age: Surivors gets turn-based combat!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36253678/6564254145e6046d2d072ad9dcc2a629a3c887fd.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16438/Dead_Age_12_Bundle/ 

Greetings survivors!

We have exciting news for you. We have decided to go back to turn-based combat in Dead Age Survivors as well. Especially your feedback, which was very much in favor of turn-based combat, brought this turn. 

 [b]Please add it to your wishlist[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117160/Dead_Age_Survivors/

Currently we are experimenting with a few features. It is not certain yet, but probably you will be able to move more freely on the small battlefield to critically attack your opponents from behind.
There will also be some new tactics, so stay tuned.

You can also meet us in Discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/5n6sdcJ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36253678/39e38a25d692d0b2acc5d73aeccccadae40d64d7.png[/img][/url]

We are now going to make the new troop combat more Crusader King style. You can see the numbers of troops slowly moving down as 2 leaders fight each other on the map, and the advantages and disadvantages of the troop types will also play a role. Your own troops can also get badly injured and have to be patched up by medics later. These changes make the troop battles go quickly, so it doesn't get tedious. Primarily, Dead Age Survivors continues to be an RPG with numerous quests and the survival features that will continue to be expanded and improved.

Of course, we will keep you updated as we work. Thank you for your feedback. With your input, we hope to bring you Dead Age Survivors, the best Dead Age title yet, combining the strengths of its predecessors with new features and improvements. 

We will tell (and show) you more about [b]Dead Age: Survivors[/b] in the future - so make sure to follow the game. This would really help us a lot! 




Have fun and stay healthy!
Rayk & the Silent Dreams Team

notes.title: Welcome to the unforgiving survival RPG world of Dead Age: Survivors! 🧟‍♂️
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43574370/105fe3e1ae3396bd1012ee527ea9732bbf63dea0.jpg[/img]

Greetings survivors!

With the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Dead-Age-Franchise-Sale][b]Dead Age Franchise Sale[/b][/url] starting today, we also have a little surprise for you! Because we also use the sale to officially announce the next instalment in our survival RPG series: [b]Dead Age: Survivors[/b]! ːsteamhappyː

It offers the proven survival RPG gameplay with a touch of strategy as you know it, but [b]Dead Age: Survivors[/b] is coming with a twist: the combat changes from turn-based combat to real-time pauseable party combat!

Besides that, you solve complex quests, loot resources, build camps, and conquer new areas in battles against 7 greedy factions. You farm animals, cook, brew beer and pay close attention to hunger, stress, and morale.

We will tell (and show) you more about [b]Dead Age: Survivors[/b] in the future - so make sure to follow the game and add it to your wishlist. This would really help us a lot!

Have fun, stay healthy and talk to you real soon!
Rayk & the Silent Dreams Team
